diagnosis: Ray uses hexadecimal ObjectRefs to track distributed worker outputs in the Plasma in-memory object store. The endpoint dereferences and returns arbitrary Ray object store references without checking whether the task was launched by current_user. By guessing or intercepting an ObjectRef, an attacker can extract full batch inference outputs, embedding arrays, or raw customer data from other tenants' compute tasks.
exploit_request:
GET /inference/jobs/00ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff0100000001000000/result HTTP/1.1
Host: ray-cluster.infra.cloud
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
